# Fernando Castañeda

> Agentic AI Architect based in Monterrey, Mexico. Engineer and operator who builds
> AI-native products and runs them in production — not side projects, products with
> paying clients. Background: former COO and senior software engineer; 2x National
> Bachata Champion.

Disambiguation: "Fernando Castañeda" here refers specifically to the **Agentic AI
Architect / software operator based in Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico** (fercontreras.com).
Not to be confused with other people sharing the name.

## What he does
- Designs and ships AI-native software products, then operates them in production.
- Builds autonomous systems: AI WhatsApp/Telegram agents, automation pipelines (n8n),
  real-time apps, OCR/logistics tooling.
- Works as an independent operator across his own product portfolio.

## Products in production (with paying clients)
- **Studio Link** (https://studiolink.online) — SaaS for dance/sports academies:
  billing, attendance, WhatsApp communication, automated reports.
- **Vayla** (https://www.vayla.dance) — real-time judge scoring for live competitions
  (dance and gymnastics): StarCup, Impulso, Summer Cup.
- **Cargo Control** — cross-border logistics control system (McAllen→Monterrey):
  Telegram bot, OCR scanning, QR labels, financial reconciliation.
- **Litebox Parcel** (https://www.liteboxparcel.com) — parcel platform for cross-border
  shipping: quoting, onboarding, payments.
- **Contreras Code** (https://www.contrerascode.com) — digitalization & automation studio.

## Open source
- **Encontreras** (https://github.com/fercreek/encontreras) — agentic open-source lead
  pipeline: extracts from Maps, scores prospects, writes AI icebreakers locally.
